_about: Public-domain William Wallace Everts, Baptist pastor in Chicago, for the Word Hoard: Words in Earnest, Compend of Christian Doctrines held by Baptists, The Bible in Schools, House of God, his life of William Colgate, The Sabbath, and Concise Comments on Baptism. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 133 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

everts-words-in-earnest: Words in Earnest: Or, The Path of Wisdom Made Plain (Edward H. Fletcher, 1852)
everts-compend: Compend of Christian doctrines held by Baptists : in catechism (Chicago : Church & Goodman, 1866)
everts-bible-in-schools: The Bible in schools (Chicago : Kennedy & Sumner, 1870)
everts-house-of-god: House of God : or claims of public worship (New York : American Tract Society, 1872)
everts-william-colgate: William Colgate: The Christian layman (Philadelphia, American Baptist publication society, 1881)
everts-sabbath: The Sabbath : its permanence, promise, and defence (New York : E. B. Treat, 1885)
everts-comments-baptism: Concise Comments on Baptism: With References Verified (American Baptist Publication Society, 1890)

_excluded.everts-selections: the Bible Manual, Scripture School Reader, Pastor's Hand-book and Book of Worship are selections of Scripture and hymns
_excluded.everts-others: the John Foster, Manhood, Christian Womanhood and the life of Everts himself are by others
